profile.migration_strategy_justification: The existing installer-campaign rows are atomically replaced by the approved exact ten-case Machine QA contract.

invariants: The yoke project owns exactly one installer-campaign plan with ten semantic cases in the approved order.
The method split is exactly four Terminal checks, three Terminal inspections, and three Machine state checks.
Exactly two cases declare host baselines: path-on-shell and cold-start-hosted each declare fresh-host and shell-preconfigured, yielding exactly twelve materialized requirements.
path-on-shell precedes cold-start-hosted so each shared baseline is inspected before the installer mutates it.
welcome-frame is baseline-free and launches the real public installer with a process-local minimal macOS system PATH that deterministically excludes user-installed uv/uvx before consent.
Every case is executable: there are zero execution blockers, zero synthetic credential fixtures, and every Terminal case has a bounded entry surface and required completion.

Hosted browser flows wait for operator approval, send Enter to poll, capture the connected token-success frame, and only then continue to machine GitHub; direct machine-only flows auto-route to Review after backlog-only.
The hosted journey uses the current browser-approval path against Stage, while apply-handoff proves the distinct local Apply, report, successful exit, and public-installer parent handoff.
The migration digest binds the exact ten-case source contract.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The physical Test Mac proof remains an explicit execution prerequisite; the migration installs executable contracts but does not claim a case verdict.
